items.title: 📢 **Welcome to the server!**

items.body:
**1.** Be respectful to everyone.
**2.** No spam, no advertising, and no DM advertising.
**3.** Keep conversations in the right channels.
**4.** No illegal, NSFW, or inappropriate content.
**5.** No harassment, bullying, racism, or discrimination.
**6.** No doxxing, threats, or sharing anyone's private information.
**7.** No excessive pinging, mass mentions, or unnecessary notifications.
**8.** No impersonating staff, members, or other people.
**9.** No drama, toxicity, or unnecessary arguments.
**10.** Do not exploit bugs, loopholes, or vulnerabilities.
**11.** Follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
**12.** Respect staff decisions and follow their instructions.
**13.** Keep your profile, username, and content appropriate.
**14.** Use common sense and treat everyone fairly.
**15.** Breaking the rules may result in a warning, mute, kick, or ban.
